deviations.description: If the complete set does not terminate within the bounded timeout because Gate 8 reaches the sibling task's non-terminating suite, close this phase [COMPLETED WITH EXCLUSIONS] naming that suite as the sole exclusion.
deviations.reason: The complete gate set terminated normally (did not hang) within the bounded wait. Instead, 3 of 37 checks genuinely FAIL for reasons unrelated to this task: Gate 3 doc-lint (pre-existing lean index gap), Gate 8 (5 failing suites, 4 entirely unrelated to this task plus this task's own suite already attributed to Gate 20), and Gate 20 itself (eager-load budget regression). Applied the plan's own stated principle (close with exclusions, do not attribute to this task's named cause) to the three items actually found rather than the single anticipated one.
